description: Java source code for SaslRpcHandler class, implementing SASL authentication handling in Spark network module.

classes.name: SaslRpcHandler
classes.description: Handles SASL authentication for Spark network connections, delegating to a child RPC handler after successful authentication.

methods.name: doAuthChallenge
methods.description: Performs SASL challenge-response authentication, sets up encryption if negotiated, and manages connection state.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the network channel becomes inactive.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the authentication process, optionally disposing of the SASL server.
